name: pr-risk-scorer
description: PR Risk Scorer: GitHub App that scores pull request risk, with a Fastify API/worker and a Next.js dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter backend dev:api" "pnpm --filter backend dev:worker" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter backend start" "pnpm --filter backend start:worker" "pnpm --filter frontend start"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test
